title: Preserve local fault support and both conditions needed for reusable EC
statement: A good completed macro G_j tensor I_M on the WHOLE admitted mediator space lets each bad contact macro remain one faulty abstract gate on its endpoint pair with ordered common-memory coefficients; source-idle faults retain their own support. The initial one-pass controller fails arbitrary-input output containment despite clean-input success. The supplied conventional two-pass Flag1-FTEC separately corrects clean inputs with one fault and maps arbitrary inputs with at most one fault into the weight-one-error subspace of some codeword. Reported exact enumerations cover2663343 arbitrary-input single-fault cases across direct/closed/reset buses.

requires: For fault-support compilation: whole admitted mediator closure and stated active-contact/source-idle/bath support; small marginal fault rates do not supply forced-subset bounds
provides: Reported internally accepted reusable fault-support compiler and corrected fully specified syndrome witness
assumptions: Arbitrary initially correlated data/mediator/bath/reference inputs allowed only under stated active contact/idle/local addressing contract
The arbitrary-input containment condition does not recover logical information already lost by an uncorrectable input
No faults in trusted address/lookup logic, uncontrolled leakage continuation or marginal-rate-to-threshold promotion
Finite checks and mathematical ideal final recovery criterion do not insert an extra physical decoder between rounds
costs: Coherent fine-syndrome storage/lookup, converter pointers and retirement/reset require their own costs; irreversible-sector count is not reset heat or detector-qubit count
Two-pass FTEC clean closed-bus round:288 contacts,168 source H,5016 total executed locations including4488 idles; max384 contacts,222 H,6626 locations. Potential6676 slots are not all executed

Direct/closed/reset-assisted source CNOTs respectively1 direct gate/4 contacts/3 contacts; closed versus reset-assisted both2 source H, reset-assisted1 qualified reset. Parallel bounded-degree service requires linear coupler supply and calibrated ports

contract.obstruction: A controller that contains faults only on clean inputs is not the complete reusable error-correction interface.
